name: Desert Mirage
line: Desert Living, Late Into The Evening
lede: In the Sonoran Desert, a home built to bring the outside in needed its patio warm on cold evenings. A freestanding Eclipse heater arches over the lounge, giving warmth and light, and moves wherever the evening goes.

hero.caption: Photograph published with the case study (credited there to Chris Smith and Istoria Films).

photos.caption: The covered terrace and stone fireplace wall. Bromic-published photograph from the case study.
The home at dusk. Bromic-published photograph from the case study.

beats: Framed by the McDowell Mountains, the home pairs expansive indoor and outdoor living with large glazed walls and glass hallways, bringing the desert landscape inside.
The owners wanted convenience and luxury, and a patio they could use on colder evenings, as part of a design that joins indoor and outdoor living.
An Eclipse Smart-Heat Freestanding infrared heater stands on the patio, with an integrated dimmable LED light. It is not fixed in place, so it can be moved across the patio as needed.

quote.text: The clients are here throughout fall, winter, and spring and they entertain frequently and spend a lot of time outside.
